howto.name: Upload a HEIC image
howto.text: Select a HEIC or HEIF file (e.g., from an iPhone photo export).

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The tool decodes via libheif and writes a PNG that opens in every browser and image editor.

faq.q: What's HEIC and why convert it?
faq.a: HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) is Apple's image format from iOS 11 onward. It's space-efficient but not widely supported outside Apple's ecosystem. PNG works everywhere.

faq.q: Is PNG better than JPG for HEIC conversion?
faq.a: If you need transparency or are doing further editing: yes. For sharing on the web or attaching to emails: JPG is fine and 3–5x smaller.
Most are stripped during conversion (since PNG and HEIC have different metadata formats). If you need to preserve EXIF, use HEIC to JPG instead and the standard EXIF block survives.
